reviews.title: Wrong translation
reviews.text: The translation uses words like “ rent” in surah 21:30  instead it should have said “split”. This is a questionable app on who owns this app

reviews.title: Don’t recommend this app version
reviews.text: Alhamdulillah. Nice app for tracking prayer times, although I don’t appreciate how the wording constantly changes.

reviews.title: Um
reviews.text: This app could be better. When I am using the Quibla direction part. It is very very inaccurate. And not to mention the way the Quran is translated is NOT how it is translated in the Quran. There’s extra parts and parts missing. I ended up just going to Quran.com to read. Please fix it

reviews.title: Needs a disclaimer may be from incomplete Quran Manuscript..
reviews.text:
There is so much to gain in wisdom from the Quran, especially when it relates back to Old Testament and New Testament as sources. Ultimately what is considered perfect in belief/obedience is in the Commandments. Which are found in Duetorodomy, Chapter 5 for the Commands/Commandments/Ten Commandments (synonyms).. otherwise very nice app, much improved, but needs Reference Quran like Bible Versions/New Quran Translations.. and languages. This version seems to be limited by the original Quran manuscripts.. especially at Suruh 2  Al-Baqarah (Al-Boqoro), good but incomplete.. Overall this Quran App may get A++ for effort but only two stars for its marginal progressive steps forward. Everyone has embraced emerging and innovated features in their prospective Bible Apps, let’s us hope these developers are just getting started. Thank you..

Pro Tip: A copy and paste function for educational purposes..
Suggestion: Maybe start a forums/clubs and generate interest in building new reference Quran version databases, doesn’t hurt to try. More LIGHT in the world is much appreciated.. God/Allah will Bless you, thanks for your time reading this review..

reviews.text: Words are changed, this is very dangerous.

reviews.title: Terrible…
reviews.text: At first, I really did enjoy it. I loved reading all of the Quran verses and memorizing them! But after a while, one of my Christian friends told me the verses were the same as the bible verses she read!!! So I asked my mom, and she told me the verses in the app are all from the bible!!
